messages:
kai: In today's onboarding we hit several quickstart inconsistencies that block new devs: node sample missing await, python env var name mismatch, and a few curl examples that assume creds are already set.

nora: Oof. Which files? I can pick one up.

kai: node: docs/quickstart/node/README.md (missing await on client.generate). python: docs/quickstart/python/README.md (export REDWOOD_KEY vs SDK reading REDWOOD_API_KEY). curl: docs/reference/http.md has a spot that drops Authorization header.

rahul: I'll do the node change — tiny PR to add `await` and a note about async context.

nora: I'll fix python + curl in one PR. For curl I'll add `-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"` and a comment: "set via env or CI, don't commit keys." Also propose swapping naive retry sample with a one-line call to the SDK's retry helper and link to /docs/guides/retries.md.

dev-docs-bot: Reminder: Samples must include a one-sentence intro and avoid realistic secrets per STYLEGUIDE.

kai: thanks. small fixes, high impact — please drop PR links here when ready.

rahul: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/540 (node await + comment).

nora: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/541 (python env var, curl header, retry link, onboarding checklist note).

kai: will smoke-test after merge. :white_check_mark:
